statements.quote: Our NAND revenue record was led by data center SSD sales, which exceeded $1 billion in quarterly revenue for the first time,” said Micron Technology President and CEO Sanjay Mehrotra.
statements.notes: Quarterly (fiscal Q4 2024) figure, not full-year; 'exceeded $1 billion' is a lower bound recorded as $1B. Covers data center SSD revenue only, not all data center or AI revenue.

statements.quote: Micron delivered 93% year-over-year revenue growth in fiscal Q4, as robust AI demand drove a strong ramp of our data center DRAM products and our industry- leading high bandwidth memory.
statements.notes: The 93% is total revenue growth for fiscal Q4 and is attributed to AI demand. It is not a share of revenue. The sentence gives no amount for data center DRAM or HBM revenue.
